name: Kushiroshitsugen National Park
description: Japan's largest wetland (designated 1987) and the home of the red-crowned crane; boardwalks and a riverside train offer views over the vast marsh.
notes: Designated 1987 (28,788 ha). Best in winter for cranes and summer for marsh flowers; the Hosooka observation deck is a highlight.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
